# basal serve --config serve.example.yml
# (`basal serve` reads basal-serve.yml from the working directory without --config; `basal init` writes a short one)
#
# Models served by one process. A request goes to the model named in its "model" field (the name in the model's
# basal.json); /v1/basal requests without the field go to default_model.

addr: 0.0.0.0:8000
default_model: basal-1.5-max       # default: the first model
max_inflight: 1024                 # waiting + running requests of all models; more get 529
long_slice_ms: 100                 # least work of a long-request lane between two hand-overs of the GPU
access_log: false                  # one log line per request: [POST] 200 /v1/systemone 31 ms (queue, compute, batch)
metrics: false                     # opt in to Prometheus collection and GET /metrics (also --metrics)
gemm_cache: .cache/gemm            # tables of `gemm_table: auto`

models:
  - repo: Remek/basal-1.5-max      # Hugging Face repository, downloaded at start into HF_HOME (HF_TOKEN if needed)
    revision: be1b5ee7e7a9755a931262fa7fab4f59be0fd03c   # branch, tag or commit (default: main)
    # auto (default): the batch-invariant GEMM table of this model, dtype and GPU from gemm_cache; generated at start
    # when missing or made for another GPU / cuBLASLt (one-time, minutes). none: algorithms timed at first use
    # (results may depend on the batch). Otherwise the path of a `basal gemm-search --invariant` table.
    gemm_table: reports/rust-cuda-1.5-max/gemm-equiv/gemm-algos-f16-invariant-groups.json
    dtype: f16                     # f16 (default), bf16, f32
    max_batch_tokens: 8192         # packed tokens of one batch
    schedule: hrrn                 # hrrn (default) or fifo
    long_tokens: 4096              # requests above this run in the model's long lane (0: none)
    state_cache_mb: 0              # cross-request state cache (0: off)

  - path: .models/basal-1.5-4.5B   # or a local model directory

  - path: .models/basal-1.5-mini

addr: "[::1]:8000"
max_inflight: 32
release_date: "2026-10-15"
default_model: fixture
long_slice_ms: 20
access_log: true
metrics: true
gemm_cache: "cache/żółć"
models:
- path: .models/mini
  repo: null
  revision: null
  dtype: bf16
  gemm_table: none
  max_batch_tokens: 128
  schedule: fifo
  long_tokens: 0
  state_cache_mb: 16
  tree_max_tokens: 8192
  no_prefix_cache: true

release_date: true
models: [{path: x, revision: true}]

release_date: false
models: [{path: x, revision: false}]

release_date: null
models: [{path: x, revision: null}]

release_date: !!binary eA==
models: [{path: x, revision: !!binary eA==}]

release_date: !custom x
models: [{path: x, revision: !custom x}]
models: [{<<: {path: x, dtype: f32}, path: y}]
